clue.text: Arrive once more to harvest fruit

parts.note: to harvest a crop is to reap it
a pear is a fruit

explanation.surface: Someone comes back to gather the fruit crop.
explanation.definitionFit: To come back into view or turn up again is to show up a second time.

clue.text: Engineers on this French boat get a break

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers
ce is French for this

clue.text: Rating a motorway overseas

explanation.surface: A sailor takes a highway to foreign parts.
explanation.definitionFit: In a foreign country, out of one's own land.

clue.text: It's self-respect makes coppers go on

parts.note: coppers are pennies, and P stands for pence
to ride is to go on a horse or vehicle

explanation.surface: Police officers ride on with dignity.
explanation.definitionFit: Dignity and a sense of one's own worth.

clue.text: Unrelenting six-footer pursuing a mother

parts.note: a dam is an animal's mother

explanation.surface: An insect chases a mother relentlessly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'six-footer' suggests a tall person, but means an insect with six legs.

clue.text: Viewing outside broad cast and waiting for follow-up

clue.text: Offered to look after injured deer

parts.note: to tend is to look after

indicators.note: injured suggests damage, so the letters of deer are jumbled

clue.text: Knitwear for town

explanation.surface: A woolly garment named after a place.

clue.text: Seat unruly sailors at the back

parts.note: RN is the Royal Navy, a body of sailors

explanation.surface: Disorderly naval men are seated behind the others.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unruly' looks like it describes the sailors, but it signals the anagram of the word before it; 'at the back' is the nautical definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A nautical term for toward or at the rear of a vessel.

clue.text: A beast gaining sup port

explanation.surface: An animal finds backing.

clue.text: Deadlock involving old ship's officer

clue.text: Decoration of the church in the French way

parts.note: rue is French for street or way

clue.text: Shy players

explanation.surface: Timid performers.

clue.text: Anxiously anticipate arrest

explanation.surface: Dreading being taken into custody.

clue.text: Put out yet again concerning one's petition

parts.note: re means about or concerning
one's is I'S, with I as the Roman numeral one
to sue is to petition or plead

explanation.surface: A request is published a second time.
explanation.definitionFit: Publishing or releasing something once more is the sense of putting it out anew.

clue.text: A fan-ardent he may well be!

parts.note: the mina, or myna, is a bird that mimics speech

explanation.surface: Putting forward a silent bird and a musical note.

clue.text: Medico getting work through a dispenser

per means by way of or through

explanation.surface: A doctor gets a job done via a pharmacist.
explanation.definitionFit: A small tube with a squeeze bulb that releases liquid drop by drop.

clue.text: Some people areal ways genuine

explanation.surface: Certain people never fake it.
explanation.definitionFit: Authentic, not fake.

clue.text: Change gear in high dudgeon

indicators.note: change tells the solver to alter the order of the letters of gear

explanation.surface: A driver changes gear angrily.

clue.text: Admonish salesman over range available

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative
to range is to wander or rove

explanation.surface: Telling off a salesman about the choice on offer.

clue.text: Watch out for a worker encompassing conflict

parts.note: a worker bee
war is armed conflict

clue.text: Accede as directed

parts.note: sent means directed or dispatched

explanation.surface: Agreeing to do as instructed.
explanation.definitionFit: Agreement or consent.

clue.text: A person who never wanted to leave home

definitions.text: A person who never wanted to leave home

parts.words: A person who never wanted to leave home
parts.note: reads like a homebody, but describes someone banished from their country against their will

explanation.definitionFit: Someone banished from their native land had no wish to depart.

clue.text: Seems to accept a point made by peace-makers

parts.note: seems means appears
SE, south-east, is a point of the compass

clue.text: Am at the finish, for a change

clue.text: Used to coat drunken men with ale

clue.text: He'd a date-new tie

indicators.note: new letters make a new arrangement of He'd a date
